children: Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:LCID) is reshaping its future—partnering with Bolt and Nvidia to deploy Level 4 AV fleets and build Lucid EVs at a new Saudi facility while exiting an AlixPartners review after planning $1.4B in 2026 cash-flow improvements to curb burn, lifting shares.
Lucid Group, Inc. Partners With Bolt
: Lucid (LCID) partners with Bolt to deploy Level 4 AVs in Europe, planning at least 25,000 Lucid EVs (target 100,000 by 2035); Lucid handles AI/autonomy and software; no financials or launch date.
: Lucid Group (LCID) ended its review with AlixPartners, targeting $1.4B cash-flow improvement for 2026 by cutting inventory, trimming capex and tightening operating costs to curb cash burn.
Lucid Group, Inc. Build Autonomous Fleet
: Lucid (LCID) will build vehicles for an autonomous fleet at a new Saudi facility, starting early next year; the fleet will use Nvidia’s Hyperion system.
: LCID shares rose after CEO said restructuring work with advisors ended; engagement with AlixPartners concluded. Intraday gains ranged about 5.9%–9% across coverage; company gave no further comment.
